_what: The adapter registry: one entry per boundary the brain calls across. An `**Adapter · <name>**` head on ANY canvas binds to the entry whose `name` matches, case-insensitive, and double-clicking it opens /forge?adapter=<name>. Read by skills/brain-viewer/adapter.py (GET /api/adapter, GET /api/adapters) and by the Ferryman pull when it rewrites a twin.

_fields.name: the word on the canvas head, lowercase
_fields.label: how the sheet titles it
_fields.app: the system on the other side, as the sheet's app column is headed
_fields.base: the base URL the callers actually use; its path is the prefix every port is spelled against
_fields.catalog: the machine-readable inventory the ports are read from, brain-relative, or null when the system does not describe itself
_fields.twin: where the markdown twin of the sheet is written
_fields.manualGroups: port groups written BY HAND and merged with the catalog's (the owner's ask, 2026-09-18, viewer Q-0024). Each is {resource, ports:[{method, path, purpose, auth, callers}]}; every port it carries is marked source: manual and the sheet draws it with a dotted edge, so a hand-written claim never passes for the app's own word.

_note: Operational detail the file does not carry (which folders to scan for callers, the brain-side mirror per resource, which log lines count as this adapter's) lives beside the defaults in adapter.py. A name here that adapter.py has no defaults for still works: the host and the prefix are read off `base`, the scan defaults to skills/.

adapters._catalogNote: The onboarding app publishes no self-description: there is no GET on this base that lists its own routes, so `catalog` is null and the ports below are the five calls skills/onboarding-api-pull/pull.py actually makes, written by hand. Ledger T-0190 is the item that replaces them with the app's own answer, or confirms there will never be one.

ports.purpose: Every candidate in one line each. The diff baseline the SessionStart holon poll compares against; refreshed as a side effect of any pull.
Every candidate with every field. FULL_REFRESH reads this and rebuilds the mirror from it.
One candidate by uuid. SINGLE_PULL, the cheap call, used for interview prep and for a candidate the poll has just surfaced.
The admin .docx of one candidate's profile. A JSON content type back means the app has not generated it.
The mentee .docx of the same profile, the version a candidate may see.
